latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — AI-powered video generation from text or image prompts.

- Instantly generate 1080p MP4 videos from your text descriptions or image uploads (up to 200MB).
- Ready-to-use for content creators, marketers, and social media managers — no editing experience needed.
- Clear setup: free cloud rendering credits with simple anonymous authentication.
- Supports additional actions like uploads, exports, balance checks, and timeline edits through natural language prompts.
- Automatic session handling, robust error management, and concise feedback on progress and results.
- Flexible input formats (MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG, etc.) and easy video exports for posting or further edits.
